translations.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
translations.bsb: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
translations.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
translations.asv: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
